property_summary: After calling NETM() by the owner, the reference contract always sets the owner's balance to totalDistributed (so balances(owner) == totalDistributed); the mutant that zeroes balances[owner] breaks this by making balances(owner) == 0 for some inputs.
change_summary: Replace the NETM function body to zero out the owner's balance instead of assigning totalDistributed, changing balances(owner).
